# Upstream sync conflicts for v1.4.3

## Conflicting paths

- `ministack/services/s3.py`
- `tests/test_s3.py`

## Resume on this branch

```bash
git fetch upstream refs/tags/v1.4.3
git switch sync/ministack-1.4.3
git merge --no-ff 51dbd0618e37c9d3dcb1a63002a9b4cb5f212a92
# Resolve the paths above and run all CI gates.
git rm .github/upstream-conflicts/v1.4.3.md
git add --all
git commit
git push origin sync/ministack-1.4.3
```

The conflict report must be removed by the resolution commit.
